title: What to Do About Disintegrating Social Structures
fullTitle: Soul Feast #25 – What to Do About Disintegrating Social Structures
description: Humanity is undergoing an unprecedented shift in consciousness , and as a result, the social structures that have shaped our lives for millennia are beginning to disintegrate.

In this Soul Feast, Gary explores the origins of these structures—such as education, healthcare, business, and governance—revealing how they emerged from human experience and were built upon external power, control, and survival. Now, as our consciousness evolves beyond the five-sensory perception , these systems no longer serve us in the way they once did.
Many may wonder: What should we do about these failing structures? The old consciousness tells us to rebuild, replace, or reform them—but this is not the solution.

The transformation of these structures is not something we can construct externally but something that emerges from within. Gary invites us to consider a radical and profound approach: instead of trying to fix broken systems, we must focus on changing ourselves .

The answer lies in creating authentic power—choosing love over fear in every moment. The only way to create lasting change in our world is by aligning our personality with our soul, practicing emotional awareness, and responding consciously rather than reacting unconsciously.
